reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code answer my usual 'is it tested or just marketing' question, and $24.99 with the money-back guarantee makes it a cheap risk. I would buy one box at the launch price, not two.
objection: I have a drawer full of half-used bottles. I will only know it is worth it if I actually finish the 30 days, and after the launch price it is $29.99, which is more than I like to pay.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR report did not match my batch number, or if the guarantee turned out to be hard to claim, I would not buy.
